decision.reason: [ev-e5fc779c10a3] is a one-line changelog entry, "fix(ci): proto references bump (#21391)". It does not say which proto references were bumped, what the versions were before and after, or which component they belong to. The "ci" scope hints that only the build is affected, but the entry never says whether shipped artifacts or operators are affected. It only points to PR #21391, so we would need the PR or a diff of the release artifacts to write the subject, change, applicability and consequence.
